## `Options`

```silk
pub struct Options
```

The fixed options a command embeds with `Command.flatten`.

<a id="Options.target"></a>

### Field `target`

```silk
pub target: List<String>
```

Requested target triples, in command-line order. An empty list selects the host.

<a id="Options.optimize"></a>

### Field `optimize`

```silk
pub optimize: Optimize
```

The requested optimization. `--release` selects `Speed`.
